messages:
samir: Quick heads-up: rolling runtime 3.0.0 -> api 2.0.0 -> router 5.0. Window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Console has a small contract change behind FF. Any cross-service concerns?
lina: Sequence OK. Console FF must stay off until router confirms header passthrough. Recommend api canary 8% for 8m then 30% for 10m.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime@3.0.0, api@2.0.0(ff:header_v2), router@5.0. Preflight checks running. :robot_face:
ops-lead: Preflight note: gpu pool healthy; one node with disk pressure — avoid placing router replicas there. I'll seed dashboards for api/header-latency, router/retry-rate, runtime/kv-evict.
console-eng: Migration is additive and behind FF console.migrate_v2. We'll not start backfill until post-router stable for 10m.
samir: Rollback plan: if api canary trips, flip off FF, rollback api -> 1.9.9 and keep runtime pinned. If runtime fails, unpin api/router and rollback runtime. Pasteable commands in thread please.
lina: Adding quick cmds:
```n# rollback api
deploy-bot rollback api@2.0.0 -> api@1.9.9
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime:2.9.7
# unpin
deploy-bot unpin api
deploy-bot unpin router
```
deploy-bot: preflight results: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime+api, router smoke queued. Post-deploy hook: migration-check then e2e-smoke; failure queues rollback.
ops-lead: I'll be watching alerts. Thresholds: api/router 5xx >1.5% or p95 +200ms sustained -> hold. Also add alert for api.header.normalize.warn > 25/min.
samir: Ok kicking at 03:00 UTC. Keep decisions and any manual rollbacks here.
